about_the_game:
Play with with up to two of your friends as paranormal investigators monitoring a normal family that is stuck in a paranormal phenomena. In Blind Spot you operate outside a seemingly normal residential house and you must use your gadgets and machines to make sure the demonic family inside does not get out of the house. You have to keep an eye on this house all night and if one of the family members escape then that would be bad. Your main tool is security cameras and you will use them to monitor the family and watch out for any distortions. You must try and survive the night to win the game!

Secure The House:

The main goal of this game is to monitor a paranormal house from the outside and make sure the family inside does not escape. The family have a whole bunch of tricks up their sleeve they can use to formulate an escape and there is also strange anomalies infesting the house that you will have to watch out for. But don't fear you are equipped with many gadgets that you can use to survive the night.

The Family:

The Family will be chill maxing in there domicile, doing what they normally do. You will be equipped with surveillance gear and you must observe them for any anomalies. But the family hates being inside. They want to escape and you must prevent this from happening. If a member of the family gets out don't worry, they'll naturally go back inside when the sun comes up. But until then. I would watch your back. When a family member gets out they won't stand ideally by. They love to get busy and they will hunt and sabotage your team.

Team Work:

You can play in a team of up to 3 people or by your lonesome, it's your choice. There are many tasks you'll need to accomplish and you'll be able to split the load between your group. Have one of your good friends operating the cameras while the other runs into the house to fix things inside. You can also choose to play with nobody. This game gives you choice. You can survive the night by yourself and the game will intelligently set the difficulty to match the lack of friends.
